// diagnostic E0215

Jet.InvalidGuardMap

`` `SharedGuard.map` needs a stored field projection ``.

What

`` `SharedGuard.map` needs a stored field projection ``.

Why

A mapped guard must keep a stable stored place inside the value protected by the original lock. A computed field is a value, not a place.

Fix

Use a direct stored-field projection such as `guard.map(fn(value) { value.field })`.

Worked example
